sourcePolicy: Normalized from the user-supplied Solar Exalted Merits & Flaws Database workbook. Workbook mechanics and Solar-specific adjustments are preserved; primary-source comparison remains pending.

entries.name: Double-Jointed
entries.summary: Grappling/flexibility bonuses. +2 dice for 3-pt version to escape constraints.
entries.mechanics: Grappling/flexibility bonuses. +2 dice for 3-pt version to escape constraints. Unusually supple. +1 die to grappling/athletics/larceny. 3-pt version allows dislocating joints and resetting painlessly to slip any restraint.
notes: Unusually supple. +1 die to grappling/athletics/larceny. 3-pt version allows dislocating joints and resetting painlessly to slip any restraint.

entries.name: Pain Tolerance
entries.summary: Ignore wound penalties. Non-cumulative with other wound-negation magic.
entries.mechanics: Ignore wound penalties. Non-cumulative with other wound-negation magic. Ignore wound penalties. 3-pt ignores 1 die; 5-pt ignores 2 dice (increases difficulty of touch-based Awareness by 2); 7-pt ignores all penalties (automatically fails touch-based rolls).
notes: Ignore wound penalties. 3-pt ignores 1 die; 5-pt ignores 2 dice (increases difficulty of touch-based Awareness by 2); 7-pt ignores all penalties (automatically fails touch-based rolls).

entries.name: Large Size
entries.summary: Adds extra health levels. Size remains in all Lunar/spirit forms (noted for reference).
entries.mechanics: Adds extra health levels. Size remains in all Lunar/spirit forms (noted for reference). 4-pt: +1 -0 health level (stands >7 ft). 6-pt: +1 -0 and +1 -1 health level (stands 8-9 ft) but lose 1 die on Dex rolls for small tools.
notes: 4-pt: +1 -0 health level (stands >7 ft). 6-pt: +1 -0 and +1 -1 health level (stands 8-9 ft) but lose 1 die on Dex rolls for small tools.

entries.name: Legendary Attribute
entries.summary: Raises maximum Attribute limit by 1 dot. Can raise to 7 at Essence 6+.
entries.mechanics: Raises maximum Attribute limit by 1 dot. Can raise to 7 at Essence 6+. Celestial Exalted pay only 3 points. Can raise a Physical Attribute one dot higher than standard cap (e.g. to 6 for Essence 1-5).
notes: Celestial Exalted pay only 3 points. Can raise a Physical Attribute one dot higher than standard cap (e.g. to 6 for Essence 1-5).

entries.name: Special Resistance
entries.summary: Resisting/immunity to environmental toxins, diseases, or alcohol poisoning.
entries.mechanics: Resisting/immunity to environmental toxins, diseases, or alcohol poisoning. Adds +1 die per point to resist poison or disease (max 5 dice). Total immunity to a single toxin/disease for 1 point. Immunity to alcohol poisoning for 1 point.
notes: Adds +1 die per point to resist poison or disease (max 5 dice). Total immunity to a single toxin/disease for 1 point. Immunity to alcohol poisoning for 1 point.

entries.name: Special Sense
entries.summary: Expands sensory range. Every significant expansion of a single sense costs 2 points.
entries.mechanics: Expands sensory range. Every significant expansion of a single sense costs 2 points. Allows processing stimuli beyond normal ranges (e.g., see heat/infrared, see visible light, hear high frequency, recognize pheromones).
notes: Allows processing stimuli beyond normal ranges (e.g., see heat/infrared, see visible light, hear high frequency, recognize pheromones).

entries.name: Mutation
entries.summary: Unusual/unnatural features representing Wyld or demonic ancestry.
entries.mechanics: Unusual/unnatural features representing Wyld or demonic ancestry. Useful mutations cost points equal to mutation rating + 2. Exalted can spend 2 motes to fuel mutations instead of 1 WP.
notes: Useful mutations cost points equal to mutation rating + 2. Exalted can spend 2 motes to fuel mutations instead of 1 WP.

entries.name: Common Sense
entries.summary: Decent grasp of what constitutes a good/bad/very bad idea. For new players.
entries.mechanics: Decent grasp of what constitutes a good/bad/very bad idea. For new players. Storyteller must warn player before character is about to perform an action that constitutes an obviously bad idea.
notes: Storyteller must warn player before character is about to perform an action that constitutes an obviously bad idea.

entries.name: Internal Compass
entries.summary: Automatically identify cardinal directions in Creation or the Underworld.
entries.mechanics: Automatically identify cardinal directions in Creation or the Underworld. Has an uncanny sense of direction. Gains +1 die to navigate ships or find way through mazes (Wits + Awareness standard difficulty).
notes: Has an uncanny sense of direction. Gains +1 die to navigate ships or find way through mazes (Wits + Awareness standard difficulty).

entries.name: Eidetic Recall
entries.summary: Camera-like recall of details, speeches, or visual elements under stress.
entries.mechanics: Camera-like recall of details, speeches, or visual elements under stress. Perfect memory of everything witnessed. Costs 1 point per sense, or a flat 3 points for Alchemical Exalted.
notes: Perfect memory of everything witnessed. Costs 1 point per sense, or a flat 3 points for Alchemical Exalted.

entries.name: Virtue Specialty
entries.summary: Increases Virtue's effective rating when character wishes to act against it.
entries.mechanics: Increases Virtue's effective rating when character wishes to act against it. Moral resolve strengthened under certain conditions. Adds dice to Virtue rolls equal to half the points invested (max 3 specialty dice for 6 points).
notes: Moral resolve strengthened under certain conditions. Adds dice to Virtue rolls equal to half the points invested (max 3 specialty dice for 6 points).

entries.name: Driving Passion
entries.summary: Live for a cause (e.g. avenging a loved one, becoming a peerless swordsman).
entries.mechanics: Live for a cause (e.g. avenging a loved one, becoming a peerless swordsman). Must be tied directly to Nature. Adds +1 die to all rolls directly furthering the goal. Resolving/fulfilling the passion grants 6 experience points.
notes: Must be tied directly to Nature. Adds +1 die to all rolls directly furthering the goal. Resolving/fulfilling the passion grants 6 experience points.

entries.name: Tactical Instincts
entries.summary: Intuitive understanding of tactics on the battlefield or in Gateway boards.
entries.mechanics: Intuitive understanding of tactics on the battlefield or in Gateway boards. Dawn Caste Solars pay only 2 points. Roll Wits + Lore to accumulate a pool of up to 3 extra dice to add to Lore/strategy or Presence combat rolls.
notes: Dawn Caste Solars pay only 2 points. Roll Wits + Lore to accumulate a pool of up to 3 extra dice to add to Lore/strategy or Presence combat rolls.

entries.name: True Love
entries.summary: If lover perishes, the Merit is lost immediately without compensation.
entries.mechanics: If lover perishes, the Merit is lost immediately without compensation. Abiding romance. Adds +1 die to all rolls made in defense or aid of that love. Regain 1 temporary Willpower each morning.
notes: Abiding romance. Adds +1 die to all rolls made in defense or aid of that love. Regain 1 temporary Willpower each morning.

entries.name: True Paragon
entries.summary: Exudes honor/nobility. Betraying the code loses the Merit immediately.
entries.mechanics: Exudes honor/nobility. Betraying the code loses the Merit immediately. Only characters with Paragon Nature. Can raise Virtues above 5 to raise permit maximum. Can roll highest Virtue in Conviction roll to regain WP.
notes: Only characters with Paragon Nature. Can raise Virtues above 5 to raise permit maximum. Can roll highest Virtue in Conviction roll to regain WP.

entries.name: Jack of All Trades
entries.summary: Preternatural edge in applying basic skills without training.
entries.mechanics: Preternatural edge in applying basic skills without training. Broad basis of knowledge. Can roll any standard Ability without suffering untutored penalties.
notes: Broad basis of knowledge. Can roll any standard Ability without suffering untutored penalties.

entries.name: Favor
entries.summary: Someone of equal or greater power owes the character a favor.
entries.mechanics: Someone of equal or greater power owes the character a favor. Under Yu-Shan/spirit court politics, minor Celestial favor is worth 2 points, moderate is 4, major is 6 points.
notes: Under Yu-Shan/spirit court politics, minor Celestial favor is worth 2 points, moderate is 4, major is 6 points.

entries.name: Heirloom
entries.summary: Owns a treasured relic, gift, or asset representing Resources value +1.
entries.mechanics: Owns a treasured relic, gift, or asset representing Resources value +1. Character owns a piece of property more valuable than lifestyle/resources afford. Most weapons/armor with Heirloom are exceptional.
notes: Character owns a piece of property more valuable than lifestyle/resources afford. Most weapons/armor with Heirloom are exceptional.

entries.name: Hidden Manse
entries.summary: Controls a Manse forgotten to history or geomantic maps (veiled in mystery).
entries.mechanics: Controls a Manse forgotten to history or geomantic maps (veiled in mystery). 1 point for hidden Demesne, 2 points for hidden Manse. Must have Manse Background. Ideal secure headquarters.
notes: 1 point for hidden Demesne, 2 points for hidden Manse. Must have Manse Background. Ideal secure headquarters.

entries.name: Heir Apparent
entries.summary: Will receive an inheritance from parents or benefactor. Requires Resources 4+.
entries.mechanics: Will receive an inheritance from parents or benefactor. Requires Resources 4+. Every point invested grants 2 dots of Backgrounds upon inheritance (max 5 points/10 dots). Specific conditions apply.
notes: Every point invested grants 2 dots of Backgrounds upon inheritance (max 5 points/10 dots). Specific conditions apply.

entries.name: Legendary Artifact
entries.summary: Owns a relic of world-shaking power that defines the epoch of their use.
entries.mechanics: Owns a relic of world-shaking power that defines the epoch of their use. ST veto applies. Relic on par with Mantis of Brigid or Eye of Autochthon. Attracts extreme danger and covetous gods/demons.
notes: ST veto applies. Relic on par with Mantis of Brigid or Eye of Autochthon. Attracts extreme danger and covetous gods/demons.

entries.name: Cache
entries.summary: Wealth hidden or legally stored in banks in multiple major cities.
entries.mechanics: Wealth hidden or legally stored in banks in multiple major cities. 1 point per city beyond home city. Allows full access to Resources or Salary at these locations.
notes: 1 point per city beyond home city. Allows full access to Resources or Salary at these locations.

entries.name: Alternative Divination
entries.summary: Allows crudely divining fate through alternative methods. Can be bought multiple times.
entries.mechanics: Allows crudely divining fate through alternative methods. Can be bought multiple times. Divines fate through tea leaves, entrails, spider webs, etc. Increased difficulty compared to astrology (difficulty 5+, takes a scene).
notes: Divines fate through tea leaves, entrails, spider webs, etc. Increased difficulty compared to astrology (difficulty 5+, takes a scene).

entries.name: Terrestrial Bloodline
entries.summary: Mortal children roll a 1 on a d10 to Exalt. (Normal mortals have no chance).
entries.mechanics: Mortal children roll a 1 on a d10 to Exalt. (Normal mortals have no chance). Solars can purchase and retain this Merit until they reach Essence 4. Greatly increases odds of children Exalting as Dragon-Blooded.
notes: Solars can purchase and retain this Merit until they reach Essence 4. Greatly increases odds of children Exalting as Dragon-Blooded.

entries.name: Priest
entries.summary: Recognized priest. Decreases prayer difficulties by 1. Zenith Caste gets 1-pt version.
entries.mechanics: Recognized priest. Decreases prayer difficulties by 1. Zenith Caste gets 1-pt version. Zenith Caste Solars get the 1-point Priest Merit automatically FOR FREE as an innate aspect of Exaltation. 7-pt Priest allows calling miracles.
notes: Zenith Caste Solars get the 1-point Priest Merit automatically FOR FREE as an innate aspect of Exaltation. 7-pt Priest allows calling miracles.

entries.name: Destiny
entries.summary: Fate written large in stars. Propelled toward a glorious (or tragic) end.
entries.mechanics: Fate written large in stars. Propelled toward a glorious (or tragic) end. 1 pt: good health. 2 pt: financial prosperity. 3 pt: destiny of a king/elder. 4 pt: general/hero of song. 5 pt: emperor/world-shaper.
notes: 1 pt: good health. 2 pt: financial prosperity. 3 pt: destiny of a king/elder. 4 pt: general/hero of song. 5 pt: emperor/world-shaper.

entries.name: Signature Style
entries.summary: Combine movement and attitude. Only one purchase can benefit a single stunt.
entries.mechanics: Combine movement and attitude. Only one purchase can benefit a single stunt. Distinctive flair for stunts. Adds +1 extra die to appropriate stunts. Stacks with standard stunt dice. Max 3 purchases.
notes: Distinctive flair for stunts. Adds +1 extra die to appropriate stunts. Stacks with standard stunt dice. Max 3 purchases.

entries.name: Sworn Brotherhood
entries.summary: Bond linking characters in common purpose. Very rare outside Dragon-Blooded.
entries.mechanics: Bond linking characters in common purpose. Very rare outside Dragon-Blooded. Shares an oath with a rating equal to the number of members. Promotes ultimate loyalty and coordination.
notes: Shares an oath with a rating equal to the number of members. Promotes ultimate loyalty and coordination.

entries.name: Taint's Warning
entries.summary: Senses the approach of unclean things. Costs 1 mote (reflexive/automatic).
entries.mechanics: Senses the approach of unclean things. Costs 1 mote (reflexive/automatic). Solars pay 2 points. reflexively sense demons, deathknights, Deathlords, undead, etc. within permanent Essence in yards. Lights Caste Mark.
notes: Solars pay 2 points. reflexively sense demons, deathknights, Deathlords, undead, etc. within permanent Essence in yards. Lights Caste Mark.

entries.name: Prescient Dreamer
entries.summary: Regularly receives prophetic dreams from Unconquered Sun or fate.
entries.mechanics: Regularly receives prophetic dreams from Unconquered Sun or fate. Dreams of what may be. Requires Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty varies based on specificity) to interpret symbols.
notes: Dreams of what may be. Requires Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty varies based on specificity) to interpret symbols.

entries.name: Eternal Vow
entries.summary: If spouse dies, lose temporary Willpower equal to Compassion. Can be a 1-pt Flaw.
entries.mechanics: If spouse dies, lose temporary Willpower equal to Compassion. Can be a 1-pt Flaw. Solars, Lunars, and Abyssals only. Reincarnation of First Age marriage. May sense partner's emotions/health. Can donate Essence.
notes: Solars, Lunars, and Abyssals only. Reincarnation of First Age marriage. May sense partner's emotions/health. Can donate Essence.

entries.name: Daredevil
entries.summary: Fortune smiles on the recklessly brave. Exalted can stack with Signature Style.
entries.mechanics: Fortune smiles on the recklessly brave. Exalted can stack with Signature Style. Reflexively spend 1 Willpower to DOUBLE standard stunt dice on a physical action with a difficulty of 3 or higher.
notes: Reflexively spend 1 Willpower to DOUBLE standard stunt dice on a physical action with a difficulty of 3 or higher.

entries.name: Brigid's Heir
entries.summary: Twilight Solars have native affinity for sorcery. Exempts Ox-Body from doubling.
entries.mechanics: Twilight Solars have native affinity for sorcery. Exempts Ox-Body from doubling. Twilight Caste Solars pay only 4 points. Doubles cost and training time for standard Charms but HALVES costs/time for spells.
notes: Twilight Caste Solars pay only 4 points. Doubles cost and training time for standard Charms but HALVES costs/time for spells.

entries.name: Unusual Appearance
entries.summary: Appearance deviates notably from normal. Harder to disguise or impersonate.
entries.mechanics: Appearance deviates notably from normal. Harder to disguise or impersonate. 1 point: strikingly odd eyes/hair (scarlet, sea green, ashen white). 2 points: skin pigmentation (albinism) or completely hairless.
notes: 1 point: strikingly odd eyes/hair (scarlet, sea green, ashen white). 2 points: skin pigmentation (albinism) or completely hairless.

entries.name: Mute
entries.summary: No vocal communication. 3-pt version is actual physical damage to vocal cords.
entries.mechanics: No vocal communication. 3-pt version is actual physical damage to vocal cords. Exalted pay 1 point less (1 pt for temporary/vow of silence, 3 pt for vocal cord damage/silence). Cannot speak/vocalize.
notes: Exalted pay 1 point less (1 pt for temporary/vow of silence, 3 pt for vocal cord damage/silence). Cannot speak/vocalize.

entries.name: Sterile
entries.summary: Result of accident, illness, or birth defect. Dynasts suffer immense stigma.
entries.mechanics: Result of accident, illness, or birth defect. Dynasts suffer immense stigma. Physically incapable of siring or bearing children. Normal characters gain 1 pt; Dynastic characters gain 3 pt.
notes: Physically incapable of siring or bearing children. Normal characters gain 1 pt; Dynastic characters gain 3 pt.

entries.name: One Eye
entries.summary: Reduces peripheral vision and depth perception. Limits ranged combat accuracy.
entries.mechanics: Reduces peripheral vision and depth perception. Limits ranged combat accuracy. Only one functioning eye. Imposes a 1-die penalty to vision-based Awareness and increases ranged attack difficulties by 1.
notes: Only one functioning eye. Imposes a 1-die penalty to vision-based Awareness and increases ranged attack difficulties by 1.

entries.name: Sun-Seared
entries.summary: Sunlight uncomfortable/damaging. Extreme 6-pt version is for Abyssals/monsters.
entries.mechanics: Sunlight uncomfortable/damaging. Extreme 6-pt version is for Abyssals/monsters. Solars rarely have the 6-point version. 2 pt: albino, -1 in sunlight, 1 unsoakable bashing/hour. 3 pt: -2 in sunlight, damage every 30 mins.
notes: Solars rarely have the 6-point version. 2 pt: albino, -1 in sunlight, 1 unsoakable bashing/hour. 3 pt: -2 in sunlight, damage every 30 mins.

entries.name: Climate Sensitive
entries.summary: Experience severe discomfort or illness when outside native climate zone.
entries.mechanics: Experience severe discomfort or illness when outside native climate zone. Discomfort in environments. 2 pt: arctic/tropical. 3 pt: non-temperate. 4 pt: specific micro-region. Adds +1 to Survival/Endurance/Resistance.
notes: Discomfort in environments. 2 pt: arctic/tropical. 3 pt: non-temperate. 4 pt: specific micro-region. Adds +1 to Survival/Endurance/Resistance.

entries.name: Amputee
entries.summary: Lacks arm or leg from birth or battle. -2 penalty to Athletics/Dexterity tasks.
entries.mechanics: Lacks arm or leg from birth or battle. -2 penalty to Athletics/Dexterity tasks. Exalted receive less compensation. 1 pt: missing hand. 2 pt: missing arm. 3 pt: missing leg. 4 pt: missing both arms. 5 pt: two limbs. 6 pt: quadriplegic.
notes: Exalted receive less compensation. 1 pt: missing hand. 2 pt: missing arm. 3 pt: missing leg. 4 pt: missing both arms. 5 pt: two limbs. 6 pt: quadriplegic.

entries.name: Dying
entries.summary: Fatal condition. Cannot be cured except via truly heroic/sorcerous means.
entries.mechanics: Fatal condition. Cannot be cured except via truly heroic/sorcerous means. Terminal illness or curse. Lose 1 dot of Stamina per interval (interval is weeks/days depending on rating). Stamina 0 is death.
notes: Terminal illness or curse. Lose 1 dot of Stamina per interval (interval is weeks/days depending on rating). Stamina 0 is death.

entries.name: Small
entries.summary: Reduced physical size. Stands out in crowds, limits raw physical reach.
entries.mechanics: Reduced physical size. Stands out in crowds, limits raw physical reach. Stands 4.5 ft tall or less. Reduces effective Strength by 1 dot for weapon minimums, and lose one -1 health level.
notes: Stands 4.5 ft tall or less. Reduces effective Strength by 1 dot for weapon minimums, and lose one -1 health level.

entries.name: Disfigured
entries.summary: Wretched physical deformity. Cannot improve Appearance above 0/1.
entries.mechanics: Wretched physical deformity. Cannot improve Appearance above 0/1. 3 pt: ugly birth defects/burns. Max Appearance 1, -1 die to Social. 4 pt: monstrous, leper-like. Appearance 0, -2 to all Social.
notes: 3 pt: ugly birth defects/burns. Max Appearance 1, -1 die to Social. 4 pt: monstrous, leper-like. Appearance 0, -2 to all Social.

entries.name: Slow Healing
entries.summary: Recovers from injury at half normal rate. Highly dangerous in the Threshold.
entries.mechanics: Recovers from injury at half normal rate. Highly dangerous in the Threshold. Solars recover from wounds at the rate of normal mortals (instead of half rate). Still cannot regenerate limbs.
notes: Solars recover from wounds at the rate of normal mortals (instead of half rate). Still cannot regenerate limbs.

entries.name: Weak Immune System
entries.summary: Harder time fighting off illness. Suffer long, debilitating bouts of sickness.
entries.mechanics: Harder time fighting off illness. Suffer long, debilitating bouts of sickness. Exalted pay only 3 points. Halves dice pools to resist or throw off diseases, infections, or sicknesses.
notes: Exalted pay only 3 points. Halves dice pools to resist or throw off diseases, infections, or sicknesses.

entries.name: Diminished Attributes
entries.summary: Stunted/atrophied body. Represents old age, illness, or childhood development.
entries.mechanics: Stunted/atrophied body. Represents old age, illness, or childhood development. Gain 3 bonus points for every Physical Attribute dot forfeited during creation. Cannot spend bonus points to raise them.
notes: Gain 3 bonus points for every Physical Attribute dot forfeited during creation. Cannot spend bonus points to raise them.

entries.name: Diminished Sense
entries.summary: Partial/total loss of sense. No Exalt can lose more than one sense entirely.
entries.mechanics: Partial/total loss of sense. No Exalt can lose more than one sense entirely. Exalted receive 1 less point. Blindness is 5 pt, deafness/numbness is 3 pt, loss of smell/taste is 2 pt for Exalted.
notes: Exalted receive 1 less point. Blindness is 5 pt, deafness/numbness is 3 pt, loss of smell/taste is 2 pt for Exalted.

entries.name: Derangement
entries.summary: Curse of madness (from Wyld, trauma, or spirits). Debilitating bouts of insanity.
entries.mechanics: Curse of madness (from Wyld, trauma, or spirits). Debilitating bouts of insanity. Madness. 3 points for the first derangement, 1 point for subsequent forms. Subtract 2 dice from Social pools.
notes: Madness. 3 points for the first derangement, 1 point for subsequent forms. Subtract 2 dice from Social pools.

entries.name: Addiction
entries.summary: Addicted to a substance. Deprivation causes withdrawal penalties/damage.
entries.mechanics: Addicted to a substance. Deprivation causes withdrawal penalties/damage. 1 pt: cheap/legal (alcohol). 2 pt: rare/illegal (opium). 3 pt: dangerous (heroin, bright morning). Wyld addiction is 3 points.
notes: 1 pt: cheap/legal (alcohol). 2 pt: rare/illegal (opium). 3 pt: dangerous (heroin, bright morning). Wyld addiction is 3 points.

entries.name: Callous
entries.summary: Selfish pragmatism, lack of moral compass. Cannot begin with high Willpower.
entries.mechanics: Selfish pragmatism, lack of moral compass. Cannot begin with high Willpower. Gain 2 points for every dot of Virtues forfeited. Can't forfeit last dot. Virtues can't be >1. Max Willpower is 3.
notes: Gain 2 points for every dot of Virtues forfeited. Can't forfeit last dot. Virtues can't be >1. Max Willpower is 3.

entries.name: Nightmares
entries.summary: Wakes plagued with lingering horror, unable to find solace in slumber.
entries.mechanics: Wakes plagued with lingering horror, unable to find solace in slumber. Horrific dreams. Adds +1 to the difficulty to regain Willpower. Botching Conviction roll causes -1 on all actions for the day.
notes: Horrific dreams. Adds +1 to the difficulty to regain Willpower. Botching Conviction roll causes -1 on all actions for the day.

entries.name: Pacifist
entries.summary: Peaceful nature. Rejects violence, making combat extremely difficult.
entries.mechanics: Peaceful nature. Rejects violence, making combat extremely difficult. 3 pt: +1 difficulty to all attacks. 5 pt: cannot attack anyone without spending a WP point for the scene. Standard attack penalty.
notes: 3 pt: +1 difficulty to all attacks. 5 pt: cannot attack anyone without spending a WP point for the scene. Standard attack penalty.

entries.name: Unskilled
entries.summary: Lacks education or practiced skills. Cannot purchase Abilities with bonus points.
entries.mechanics: Lacks education or practiced skills. Cannot purchase Abilities with bonus points. Receive 1 bonus point for every dot of Abilities forfeited during character creation. Must still meet Favored minimums.
notes: Receive 1 bonus point for every dot of Abilities forfeited during character creation. Must still meet Favored minimums.

entries.name: Weak-Willed
entries.summary: Pathetic wretch with severe self-doubt and complete lack of drive.
entries.mechanics: Pathetic wretch with severe self-doubt and complete lack of drive. Only Exalted who suffered Willpower loss since Exaltation can take this. 1 point per dot of permanent Willpower forfeited.
notes: Only Exalted who suffered Willpower loss since Exaltation can take this. 1 point per dot of permanent Willpower forfeited.

entries.name: Barbarian
entries.summary: Uncivilized upbringing. Cannot read or write without separate training.
entries.mechanics: Uncivilized upbringing. Cannot read or write without separate training. Grew up outside civilized bounds. Lose 1 die from Social pools related to etiquette, cannot have Lore 2+, assumed illiterate.
notes: Grew up outside civilized bounds. Lose 1 die from Social pools related to etiquette, cannot have Lore 2+, assumed illiterate.

entries.name: Secrets
entries.summary: Discovery means ruin. 3-point secrets carry immediate death penalty.
entries.mechanics: Discovery means ruin. 3-point secrets carry immediate death penalty. Harbors an embarrassing or dangerous secret. 1 pt: inconvenient. 2 pt: criminal. 3 pt: deadly (e.g., Anathema in Realm).
notes: Harbors an embarrassing or dangerous secret. 1 pt: inconvenient. 2 pt: criminal. 3 pt: deadly (e.g., Anathema in Realm).

entries.name: Disciple
entries.summary: Must train/protect student. Failing duties leads to loss of status/Backing.
entries.mechanics: Must train/protect student. Failing duties leads to loss of status/Backing. Entrusted with a student. 1 pt: minimal attention. 2 pt: regular. 3 pt: daily/responsible. 4 pt: spoiled brat. 5 pt: malicious terror.
notes: Entrusted with a student. 1 pt: minimal attention. 2 pt: regular. 3 pt: daily/responsible. 4 pt: spoiled brat. 5 pt: malicious terror.

entries.name: Enemy/Rival
entries.summary: Opposing force actively working against the character (inverse of Allies).
entries.mechanics: Opposing force actively working against the character (inverse of Allies). Enmity of an individual or group. 5-pt version represents a god, Deathlord, First Age survivor, or Third Circle Demon.
notes: Enmity of an individual or group. 5-pt version represents a god, Deathlord, First Age survivor, or Third Circle Demon.

entries.name: Known Anathema
entries.summary: Widespread infamy. Wyld Hunt is actively tracking and trying to kill character.
entries.mechanics: Widespread infamy. Wyld Hunt is actively tracking and trying to kill character. Celestial Exalted only. 1 pt: regional fame. 2 pt: widespread. 3 pt: Hunt is active. 4 pt: Hunt marshals armies. 5 pt: Kejak/Mouth of Peace involved.
notes: Celestial Exalted only. 1 pt: regional fame. 2 pt: widespread. 3 pt: Hunt is active. 4 pt: Hunt marshals armies. 5 pt: Kejak/Mouth of Peace involved.

entries.name: Wanted
entries.summary: Wrath of authorities. Must keep low profile; capture means death/prison.
entries.mechanics: Wrath of authorities. Must keep low profile; capture means death/prison. Known criminal. 1 pt: escaped slave, defaulted loan. 3 pt: violent crime. 5 pt: treason, consorting with Deathlords/fae.
notes: Known criminal. 1 pt: escaped slave, defaulted loan. 3 pt: violent crime. 5 pt: treason, consorting with Deathlords/fae.

entries.name: Disturbing
entries.summary: Makes others highly uncomfortable. People avoid character; socially isolating.
entries.mechanics: Makes others highly uncomfortable. People avoid character; socially isolating. Exudes an indefinable mien of menace. 2 points: +1 to difficulty of all Social rolls except Intimidation. 3 points: penalty is +2.
notes: Exudes an indefinable mien of menace. 2 points: +1 to difficulty of all Social rolls except Intimidation. 3 points: penalty is +2.

entries.name: Child
entries.summary: A child Exalt. Opinions ignored, requires adult guardians to act legally.
entries.mechanics: A child Exalt. Opinions ignored, requires adult guardians to act legally. Has not yet reached physical maturity. Treated with patronizing amusement. Lose 1-3 dice from Social with adults.
notes: Has not yet reached physical maturity. Treated with patronizing amusement. Lose 1-3 dice from Social with adults.

entries.name: Damaged Artifact
entries.summary: Represents tarnished or malfunctioning First Age relic from a tomb.
entries.mechanics: Represents tarnished or malfunctioning First Age relic from a tomb. One of the character's starting artifacts is broken. 1 pt: minor damage (-1 penalty). 2 pt: major. 3 pt: useless until repaired.
notes: One of the character's starting artifacts is broken. 1 pt: minor damage (-1 penalty). 2 pt: major. 3 pt: useless until repaired.

entries.name: Debt
entries.summary: Imposes constant financial pressure. Failing to pay leads to violent pursuit.
entries.mechanics: Imposes constant financial pressure. Failing to pay leads to violent pursuit. Owes money/goods to wealthy Dynast or the Guild. Must make regular payments or face mercenaries/assassins.
notes: Owes money/goods to wealthy Dynast or the Guild. Must make regular payments or face mercenaries/assassins.

entries.name: Dark Fate
entries.summary: Fated for epic disaster. Sidereals cannot change this destiny.
entries.mechanics: Fated for epic disaster. Sidereals cannot change this destiny. Character is doomed to a terrible end (e.g. madness, damnation, treason). Evoked/unintentional curses occur regularly.
notes: Character is doomed to a terrible end (e.g. madness, damnation, treason). Evoked/unintentional curses occur regularly.

entries.name: Unlucky
entries.summary: Endless stream of misfortune. Refreshes at the end of every story.
entries.mechanics: Endless stream of misfortune. Refreshes at the end of every story. Bad luck pool equal to points. Storyteller can spend points to force rerolls (least successful applies) or cause random chaos.
notes: Bad luck pool equal to points. Storyteller can spend points to force rerolls (least successful applies) or cause random chaos.

entries.name: Greater Curse
entries.summary: Suffer more deeply from the Great Curse laid by dying Primordials.
entries.mechanics: Suffer more deeply from the Great Curse laid by dying Primordials. Celestial Exalted only. Reduces maximum Limit pool by one dot per point (max 5 dots). Undergoes Limit Break at 5 Limit instead of 10.
notes: Celestial Exalted only. Reduces maximum Limit pool by one dot per point (max 5 dots). Undergoes Limit Break at 5 Limit instead of 10.

entries.name: Permanent Caste Mark
entries.summary: Mark does not fade. Standard citizens recognize it as the sign of Anathema.
entries.mechanics: Mark does not fade. Standard citizens recognize it as the sign of Anathema. Celestial Exalted only. Caste Mark is permanently visible on brow as a tattoo. Gold for Solars. Easily recognized by Hunt.
notes: Celestial Exalted only. Caste Mark is permanently visible on brow as a tattoo. Gold for Solars. Easily recognized by Hunt.

entries.name: Beacon of Power
entries.summary: Essence flows loudly, creating massive anima flares upon any expenditure.
entries.mechanics: Essence flows loudly, creating massive anima flares upon any expenditure. Exalted only. Cannot hide divinity. Combined Personal/Peripheral pool. All spent Essence triggers totemic flare. Unusable by Night.
notes: Exalted only. Cannot hide divinity. Combined Personal/Peripheral pool. All spent Essence triggers totemic flare. Unusable by Night.

entries.name: Weak Essence
entries.summary: Waives experience cost of withheld Charms, but limits power growth.
entries.mechanics: Waives experience cost of withheld Charms, but limits power growth. Stunted magical development. Starting Essence rating is 1, severely limiting starting Charms.
notes: Stunted magical development. Starting Essence rating is 1, severely limiting starting Charms.

entries.name: Throwback
entries.summary: Possessed by past life. Must resist impulses via Willpower roll.
entries.mechanics: Possessed by past life. Must resist impulses via Willpower roll. Celestial Exalted only. Impulses/personality fragments from previous incarnation. 1 pt: inconvenient. 3 pt: feuds. 5 pt: insane/malignant voices.
notes: Celestial Exalted only. Impulses/personality fragments from previous incarnation. 1 pt: inconvenient. 3 pt: feuds. 5 pt: insane/malignant voices.

excludedForSolar.name: Prodigy
excludedForSolar.reason: NOT AVAILABLE to Solar Exalted. Solars already reach these limits as part of their Exaltation.
